import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('DuLieuBanHang.xlsx', sheet_name='DanhSachHoaDon')
print("shape:", df.shape)
print("columns:", list(df.columns))
# Search for road names across all text columns
roads = ['Lê Trọng Tấn', 'Trần Não', 'Lê', 'Trần']
for col in df.columns:
    matches = df[col].astype(str).str.contains('|'.join(roads), case=False, na=False)
    if matches.sum() > 0:
        print(f"\n=== {col} === ({matches.sum()} rows)")
        print(df.loc[matches, col].value_counts())
